releases.synopsis: The Transition Age did not begin quietly. It was declared, ratified, and widely supported in the aftermath of global collapse.

releases.title: When the Rain Came
releases.synopsis:
*“If we stay here, if we keep wandering without a real plan, we won’t last. Maybe The Hill is dangerous. But maybe it’s not. It’s the only plan we have.”*

Seventeen-year-old Aurora knows how to survive. Life in the foster system has taught her how to stay quiet, stay smart, and stay ready. But nothing could prepare her for this: a never-ending storm that swallows cities, drowns forests, and turns the world into a flooded wasteland.

Trapped in a collapsing house with her strict prepper foster parents, Aurora is forced to live by their rules just to stay alive. Until the day they disappear without a trace.

**Alone. Abandoned.** And **running out of time.**

All Aurora has is a waterlogged scrap of paper and a “The Hill.”

With looters closing in and the floodwaters rising higher each day, she’s left with **one impossible choice**—stay and wait for the storm to take her, or risk everything on a journey through the drowned remains of the world, to a find a place that may or not exist.

It’s forward or nothing.

releases.title: You Pierce My Soul
releases.synopsis: Zada climbed the filigreed steps to the grandest stage in the grandest room of City Hall, struggling to school her thoughts into something befitting the joyous occasion of her friend's marriage, and away from a swelling, choking fear that she was about to ruin the most important day of Flora's life.

releases.title: Burn the Water
releases.synopsis: **From award-winning screenwriter of *The Hunger Games* Billy Ray comes an immersive and breathtaking enemies-to-lovers epic romance about war, loyalty, and the power that love has to save... or destroy.**

releases.title: Protocol 86: Chernobyl
releases.synopsis: Protocol 86: Chernobyl is a terminal-driven psychological horror puzzle game set in a secret Soviet underground facility after the Chernobyl disaster.

releases.title: Prisoners Chess
releases.synopsis: You know how the pieces move. You don't know how they die. A chess roguelike where every piece bleeds. Level them, perk them or lose them forever. Take the enemy King's head, or bleed their army dry. One path saves you. One damns you. Hell keeps score.

releases.title: Fusty Dungeon
releases.synopsis: Travel the land and explore a dungeon with two beautiful ladies to find the cure to your childhood friend’s curse.

releases.title: Courier
releases.synopsis: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.

releases.title: Misha
releases.synopsis: It’s almost Christmas. Spend a quiet evening with Misha, where small choices can lead to unexpected consequences.

releases.title: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
releases.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

releases.title: Sender Unknown
releases.synopsis: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

releases.title: Garfield: Escape from Monday
releases.synopsis: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

releases.title: Love All My Girls
releases.synopsis: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

releases.title: Kalanoro
releases.synopsis: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

releases.title: Substrate: Emergence
releases.synopsis: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

releases.title: Frog Pond Simulator
releases.synopsis: Frog Pond Simulator is an idle incremental game where you'll see new frogs coming along continuously, each unique, funny looking and unusual. The only objective that matters is to relax and let yourself be transported by the music and the mood. An un-frog-ettable experience!

releases.title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
releases.synopsis:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges, and the most ambitious Kingdom Rush adventure yet.

Defend the past to change the future.

releases.title: Coin & Cauldron
releases.synopsis: The Kingdom of Valoria is in grave danger - The King has sent his most trusted Alchemist to help fight off the monster hordes near the town of Elyzium. Fight monsters, craft potions, cast spells and live the life of a powerful sorcerer fighting to repel the monsters from the defenseless town...

releases.title: Frukt
releases.synopsis: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

releases.title: All Roads Connected
releases.synopsis: Explore an endless world, build countless settlements, discover lost artifacts, and lead your nation into a new dawn of industry.

releases.title: Unanchored Spaceshooting
releases.synopsis: Welcome to the most counter-intuitive shooter arena! In Unanchored Spaceshooting, your guns ARE your thrusters—dodge left by firing right! Every battle defies physics. Blast enemies, rack up high scores!

releases.title: Reel Talk
releases.synopsis: Cast your line, catch some fish, and make real connections. REEL TALK is a cozy multiplayer fishing game where you hang out, customize your character with pride, and chat with friends old and new. No pressure, no competition-just good vibes by the water.

releases.title: Oh!Ware
releases.synopsis: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

releases.title: BanG Dream! Our Notes
releases.synopsis: In BanG Dream! Our Notes, players will be thrown into the stories of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, two aspiring bands discovering their voice. Guide each group from rehearsal studios to stadium shows, as you master tight, rhythm-based gameplay set to original, high-energy pop. As their journey unfolds, three more bands - Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! - join the stage, weaving a multi-route tale of youth, friendship, and musical passion. Featuring 25 characters across five bands, the game showcases their growth both on stage and in everyday life.

releases.title: Farming Camp
releases.synopsis: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

releases.title: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Among Shadows
releases.synopsis: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

releases.title: Futa Slug EX
releases.synopsis: Futa Slug EX is a top-down shooter roguelike where you collect and fuck beautiful dickgirls. Build your team and discover powerful upgrades as you pilot your SLUG through procedurally generated dungeons.

releases.title: Hirotonfa's American Revolution Smuggler
releases.synopsis: A historical trading and dating sim set during the American Revolution. Manage a trade ship hauling goods between colonial ports, profit from volatile daily market swings, and navigate faction dangers, from militias to pirates, while choosing sides that affect regional quests. Along the way, romance charming colonial “state-chans” across territories like Louisiana and Quebec, blending economic strategy, risk-filled navigation, and character-driven narrative.

releases.title: WinMon
releases.synopsis: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

releases.title: Monastery: Ora et Labora
releases.synopsis: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

releases.title: Land of Glarefall
releases.synopsis: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

releases.title: American Truck Simulator: South Dakota
releases.synopsis: Welcome to the Mount Rushmore State! From the wide-rolling plains to the rugged beauty of the Badlands and the forested peaks of the Black Hills, South Dakota’s landscapes are as diverse as they are breathtaking.

releases.title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
releases.synopsis: Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

releases.title: 3-Bit Explorer
releases.synopsis: 3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have even more bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

releases.title: Babelomania
releases.synopsis: A technogothic horror where a beautiful wedding turns into a death trap... Who will survive?

releases.title: Dragon Shelter
releases.synopsis: Dragon Shelter is a farm sim set in a fantasy world. Take on the role of a hero who will revive the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Take care of wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and restore destroyed biomes!

releases.title: Hack 'n' Stack
releases.synopsis: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game for up to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

releases.title: Doggy Don't Care
releases.synopsis: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

releases.title: Control Resonant
releases.synopsis: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

releases.title: PuPu's Adventure Park
releases.synopsis: Build an Adventure Park from the ground up! The PuPu clan had just rented a new "playground" from the Dark Goblins. Manage the park, construct park facilities, and grow your clan to serve the expansion of the Park for "hero" customers summoned from other planets!

releases.title: Silent Hill: Townfall
releases.synopsis:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

releases.title: Goofy Dungeon
releases.synopsis: Goofy Dungeon is a light-hearted puzzle game built from the ground up for VR. Explore dungeons, interact with objects and the environment, solve puzzles, complete quests and collect trophies!

releases.title: Sin: Reloaded
releases.synopsis: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!
